school: 帖木儿帝国创立者（跛足征服者，河中地区乌卢斯贵族出身，1360年代起以撒马尔罕为都，历经三十余战统一中亚与波斯，1398年洗劫德里，1402年安卡拉之战俘虏奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世，1405年死于东征明朝途中）
historical_significance: 帖木儿（1336-1405），生于撒马尔罕附近的渴石城，出身巴鲁剌思部突厥化蒙古贵族，青年时因伤致跛，故称'跛子帖木儿'（Tamerlane）。他并非成吉思汗后裔，却以娶成吉思汗系公主（'古尔坎'，意即女婿）的方式绕开血统门槛，又以伊斯兰护教者自居取得教法合法性，从一个小部族首领起家，先依附察合台傀儡可汗积累实权，再逐一剪灭合作伙伴，统一河中、波斯、花剌子模，先后击败金帐汗国脱脱迷失（1391、1395）、洗劫德里（1398，屠戮近十万）、在安卡拉之战（1402）大破并俘虏正如日中天的奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世，令奥斯曼帝国陷入十年内乱，客观上为拜占庭与欧洲续命半个世纪。他的另一面是撒马尔罕的营造者：每征服一地便把工匠、学者、艺术家迁往都城，建成比比哈尼姆清真寺、古尔·埃米尔陵等建筑群，使撒马尔罕成为世纪之交的伊斯兰世界学术与工艺中心。1405年2月在率军东征明朝途中病逝于讹答剌。其'以恐怖立威、以工匠立国、以双重合法性立身'的战争-建国一体模式，是冷兵器时代征服者思维的一个极端而完整的样本。
historical_significance_en: Timur (Tamerlane, 1336-1405), born near Shakhrisabz close to Samarkand into the Turkicized Mongol Barlas nobility, was lamed in youth and known as 'the Lame.' Not a descendant of Genghis Khan, he circumvented the bloodline barrier by marrying a Chinggisid princess (taking the title 'Gurkan,' son-in-law) and posed as a defender of Islam for religious legitimacy. From a minor tribal chief he rose by serving Chagatai puppet khans to accumulate real power, then eliminated his partners one by one, unifying Transoxiana, Persia and Khwarazm; he crushed the Golden Horde's Tokhtamysh (1391, 1395), sacked Delhi (1398, with massacres near 100,000), and at Ankara (1402) shattered and captured the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I at his zenith, plunging the Ottomans into a decade-long interregnum that in effect bought Byzantium and Europe half a century. His other face was that of a builder: after each conquest he deported artisans, scholars and artists to his capital, creating the Bibi-Khanym Mosque, the Gur-e Amir and more, making Samarkand the artistic and scholarly hub of the Islamic world. He died at Otrar in February 1405 while marching to invade Ming China. His integrated war-and-state model—terror for deterrence, deported craftsmen for nation-building, dual legitimacy for standing—is an extreme but complete specimen of conqueror's thinking in the age of cold steel.
description_zh: 征服者-营造者的思维原型：以战争重心打击摧毁对手的组织中枢，以恐怖传播压缩未来战争成本，以劫掠工匠把军事胜利转化为国家能力，以婚姻与宗教的双重合法性绕开血统与教法门槛，以终身不停歇的远征让帝国机器永保持在战时状态。
description_en: The prototype of the conqueror-builder: destroy the enemy's organizational hub by striking its center of gravity, propagate terror to lower the cost of future wars, convert military victory into state capacity by deporting artisans, bypass bloodline and religious barriers with dual legitimacy of marriage and faith, and keep the imperial machine permanently in wartime gear through ceaseless campaigns.
